supersedes_for_current_status.preservation: The prior result and index remain sealed. This file appends the Supervisor-requested frontend-profile and psutil root-cause results.

supplemental_results.scope: The previously omitted frontend profile is now directly observed. Local frontend-to-backend proxy connectivity is closed. No live-provider PASS is claimed.

supplemental_results.root_cause: psutil==5.9.8 is independently built from psutil-5.9.8.tar.gz. Random /tmp/pip-install-* source paths enter .debug_line_str, which changes the derived GNU build-id and therefore the full shared-object and wheel hashes.
supplemental_results.stage3_effect: The unknown-cause gap is closed, but bit-for-bit reproducibility remains failed. Runtime-section equality alone does not satisfy the signed-provenance and complete runtime-equivalence exception.

claim full runtime equivalence from inspected-section equality
